Generated from the v1 spec. `-2` variants are the request shapes (what you send); unsuffixed ones are mostly what you get back. Field names and enums are exact.

## Profile



- `id` — string. The objects ID Example: `"33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"`
- `uid` — string. The objects UID Example: `"profileUid"`
- `name` — string. This is the name of the profile. Example: `"Profile Name"`
- `profile_type_id` — string. This is the ID of the profile type the profile belongs to Example: `"33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"`
- `status` — string. This is the status of the profile One of: Active, Inactive, On Leave, Terminated. Example: `"Active"`
- `id_proofing_status` — string. This is the ID proofing staus of the profile One of: pending, pass, fail. Example: `"pending"`
- `created_at` — string. The date and time the profile was created Example: `"2023-11-21T14:23:54.256-05:00"`
- `updated_at` — string. The date and time the profile was updated Example: `"2023-11-21T14:23:54.256-05:00"`
- `attributes` — object. Attributes that belong to this profile. Example: `{"Non-Employee Profile ID": "The Non-Employee Profile ID (will be returned for assignments, to be used during correlation configuration)", "text_attribute_uid": "static text", "date_attribute_uid": "0`

## Profile-2

- `profile_type_id` (required) — string. The profile type id. Example: `"79ed1cb6-9977-4965-9bfe-f2bcc2424444"`
- `status` (required) — string. The profile status. One of: Active, Inactive, On Leave, Terminated. Example: `"Active"`
- `id_proofing_status` — string. The id proofing status of the profile. One of: pending, pass, fail. Example: `"pass"`

## ProfileType-2



- `id` — string. The objects ID. Example: `"33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"`
- `uid` — string. The objects UID. Example: `"ptUid"`
- `name` — string. This is the name of the profile type. Example: `"Worker"`
- `category` — string. This is the category the profile type falls into. One of: employee, non-employee, organization, assignment, other. Example: `"employee"`
- `bypass_dup_protection` — boolean. Whether or not duplication protection is bypassed. Example: `false`
- `archived` — boolean. Whether or not the profile type is archived. Example: `false`
- `permitted_role_ids` — array of string. The role ids that are permitted for this profile type. Example: `["33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"]`
- `isc_synced` — boolean. Is this profile type synced with ics Example: `false`
- `profile_type_dup_attributes` — array of object. 
  - `profile_type_dup_attributes.id` — string. The ID of the properties that are used for duplication protection.
  - `profile_type_dup_attributes.uid` — string. The user-specified identifier of the properties that are used for duplication protection.
  - `profile_type_dup_attributes.profile_type_id` — string. The ID of the profile type.
  - `profile_type_dup_attributes.ne_attribute_id` — string. The ID of the ne attribute.
- `profile_type_namings` — array of object. 
  - `profile_type_namings.id` — string. The ID of the profile type naming.
  - `profile_type_namings.uid` — string. The user-specified identifier of the profile type naming.
  - `profile_type_namings.profile_type_id` — string. The ID of the associated profile type.
  - `profile_type_namings.ne_attribute_id` — string. The ID of the associated ne attribute.
  - `profile_type_namings.order` — integer. The order that the namings are used in.

## Attribute-2



- `id` — string. The id of the attribute Example: `"ac4aae0b-4140-49a4-a84c-126762fd0c8f"`
- `uid` — string. The user-specified identifier of the attribute Example: `"myattribute"`
- `label` — string. The label for the attribute Example: `"birthday"`
- `description` — string. A description of the attribute Example: `"Your birthday"`

- `archived` — boolean. Whether the attribute is archived Example: `false`
- `date_format` — string. The format of the date input if it is a date input One of: mm/dd/yyyy, mm-dd-yyyy, dd/mm/yyyy, dd-mm-yyyy, yyyy/mm/dd, yyyy-mm-dd. Example: `"mm/dd/yyyy"`
- `selectable_status` — string. The status of the profiles that can be selected Example: `"Active"`
- `risk_type` — string. Type of risk that applies to the attribute Example: `"OverallRisk"`
- `ownership_driven` — boolean. Only shows profiles that the user currently has access to, to be selected Example: `true`
- `allow_multiple_selections` — boolean. Whether or not multiple selections can be made on something like a contributor search. Example: `true`
- `filtered_by_ne_attribute` — boolean. Whether or not the attribute is filtered by another attribute Example: `true`

- `reverse_association_attribute` — AttributeProperties. 
- `profile_type_id` — string. The ID of the profile type the attribute applies to Example: `"ac4aae0b-4140-49a4-a84c-126762fd0c8f"`
- `data_type` — string. The type of data that applies to the attribute One of: text field, text area, drop-down, radio buttons, check boxes, date, tags, attachment, profile select, profile search, owner select, owner search, contributor select, contributor search. Example: `"text field"`
- `type` — string. The attribute's type One of: AttachmentAttribute, CheckBoxesAttribute, ContributorSearchAttribute, ContributorSelectAttribute, DateAttribute, DropDownAttribute, OwnerSearchAttribute, OwnerSelectAttribute, ProfileSearchAttribute, ProfileSelectAttribute, RadioButtonsAttribute, TagsAttribute, TextAreaAttribute, TextFieldAttribute. Example: `"AttachmentAttribute"`
- `validations_attributes` — object. 
  - `validations_attributes.validation_method` — string. The type of validation to be applied One of: required, unique, date_format, days, characters, extension, numericality, email_format, custom_format, no_special_chars.
  - `validations_attributes.value` — string. The value of the validator
  - `validations_attributes._destroy` — boolean. If the validator should be removed

## CreateWorkflow



- `profile_type_id` (required) — string. The profile type the workflow effects. Example: `"33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"`
- `status` (required) — string. Whether or not the workflow is enabled or disabled. One of: Enabled, Disabled. Example: `"Enabled"`
- `uid` (required) — string. The user-specified identifier of the workflow. Example: `"my_uid"`
- `name` (required) — string. Name of the workflow Example: `"my_workflow"`
- `disable_failure_email_notifications` — boolean. When honored at runtime, suppresses failure email notifications for this workflow's sessions. Example: `false`

## UpdateWorkflow



- `profile_type_id` (required) — string. The profile type the workflow effects. Example: `"33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"`
- `status` (required) — string. Whether or not the workflow is enabled or disabled. One of: Enabled, Disabled. Example: `"Enabled"`

## BatchWorkflow

## AutomatedWorkflow



- `profile_type_id` (required) — string. The profile type the workflow effects. Example: `"33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"`
- `status` (required) — string. Whether or not the workflow is enabled or disabled. One of: Enabled, Disabled. Example: `"Enabled"`
- `uid` (required) — string. The user-specified identifier of the workflow. Example: `"my_uid"`
- `name` (required) — string. Name of the workflow Example: `"my_workflow"`
- `disable_failure_email_notifications` — boolean. When honored at runtime, suppresses failure email notifications for this workflow's sessions. Example: `false`
- `condition_rules_attributes` (required) — array of object. The ProfileTypeRule this workflow will be working with. Example: `[{"type": "ProfileTypeRule", "condition_object_type": "DateAttribute", "comparison_operator": "==", "logical_operator": "AND", "value": "true"}]`
  - `condition_rules_attributes.logical_operator` — string. The type of condition rule. One of: AND, OR.
  - `condition_rules_attributes.comparison_operator` — string. The operator used by the condition rule. One of: <, >, ==, before, include?, absent?, after.
  - `condition_rules_attributes.condition_object_id` — string. UUID for object targeted by the condition.
  - `condition_rules_attributes.condition_object_type` — string. Type of object targeted by the condition.
  - `condition_rules_attributes.secondary_value` — string. Used for time_frame comparison.
  - `condition_rules_attributes.tertiary_value` — string. Represents the days of a temporal comparison.
  - `condition_rules_attributes.value` — string. The value being compared against.
  - `condition_rules_attributes.order` — integer. If there are multiple rules against one workflow, this is the order that they are ran in.
  - `condition_rules_attributes.type` — string. The type of condition rule. One of: RiskRule, ProfileIdRule, ProfileTypeRule, ProfileExistsRule, ProfileStatusRule, SessionAttributeRule, ProfileAttributeRule, ProfileDoesNotExistRule, IdentityProofingRule.

## WorkflowAction



- `workflow_id` (required) — string. The workflow the workflow action belongs to. Example: `"33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"`
- `description` — string. The description of the workflow action. Example: `"Require approval from another user or a group of users with a specific role."`
- `page_id` (required) — string. The page the workflow action should render. Example: `"33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"`
- `add_requester_as_owner` — boolean. If the requester should be added as the owner of the profile to be created. Example: `true`
- `email_attribute_id` — string. The attribute storing the email address for the workflow action. Example: `"33f072dd-13b4-41e1-8ea0-16f2a59b57c8"`
- `email_addresses` — array of string. The email addresses for the workflow action. Example: `["johndoe@gmail.com", "janedoe@gmail.com"]`
- `new_status` — string. The new status for the Status Change workflow action. Example: `"Active, Inactive, On Leave, Terminated"`
- `archived` — boolean. If the workflow action is archived or not. Example: `false`
- `skippable` — boolean. If the workflow action is skippable or not. Example: `false`
- `requires_comment` — boolean. If the workflow action requires a comment or not. Example: `false`

## User



- `name` (required) — string. The user name Example: `"Bob"`
- `email` (required) — string. The user email Example: `"test@sailpoint.com"`
- `type` (required) — string. The user type One of: NeprofileUser, NeaccessUser. Example: `"NeprofileUser"`
- `profile_id` — string. The user profile id. Not required for NeprofileUser Example: `"db6f8e8b-65c2-47d5-a0db-90bcc4e9df9e"`
- `title` — string. The user description Example: `"my_user_title"`
- `status` — string. The user status One of: Active, Pending, Disabled. Example: `"Active"`
- `login` (required) — string. The user login Example: `"my_user"`
- `group_strings` — string. The user group strings Example: `"Administrator_group,Developer_group"`
- `locale` — string. The locale the user prefers to use Example: `"fr-CA"`
- `password` — string. The user password. Not required for NeprofileUser Example: `"U*bF7hy9fW"`
- `sailpoint_identity_id` — string. The SailPoint Identity ID associated with this user Example: `"db6f8e8b-65c2-47d5-a0db-90bcc4e9df9e"`

- `title` — string. The title Example: `"Director"`
- `status` — string. Status of the user One of: Active, Pending, Disabled. Example: `"Active"`
- `login` — string. The login Example: `"myLogin"`
- `last_login` — string. When the user last logged in Example: `"Wed, 07 Feb 2024 12:55:20.456682000 EST -05:00"`
- `cookies_accepted_at` — string. When cookies were accepted Example: `"Wed, 07 Feb 2024 12:55:20.456682000 EST -05:00"`
- `preferred_language` — string. The locale the user prefers to use Example: `"fr-CA"`
- `locale` — string. The locale the user prefers to use Example: `"fr-CA"`
- `group_strings` — string. Group strings configured on the customer's Active Directory configuration, provided by the IDP at the moment on authentication. Example: `"Admin_group, Developer_group"`
- `sailpoint_identity_id` — string. The identity ID of the user in ISC Example: `"9496f8d6ddab49c0bef1e9ee6f1b835a"`

## Role



- `id` — string. 
- `uid` — string.  Example: `"sponsors_role"`
- `name` — string.  Example: `"Sponsors"`
- `groups` — array of string. 

## Delegation



- `id` — string. The id of the delegation Example: `"ac4aae0b-4140-49a4-a84c-126762fd0c8f"`
- `delegator_id` — object. The id of the delegator user Example: `"12345678-1234-5678-1234-123456789012"`
- `delegate_id` — object. The id of the delegate user Example: `"87654321-4321-6789-4321-210987654321"`
- `expiration` — string. The expiration date of the delegation Example: `"2023-10-01T12:00:00Z"`
- `expired` — boolean. Indicates if the delegation is expired Example: `false`
- `created_at` — string. The date-time the record created. Example: `"2022-12-27 08:26:49.219717"`
- `updated_at` — string. The date-time the record was last updated. Example: `"2022-12-27 08:26:49.219717"`

## SyncedAttribute



- `ne_attribute_id` — string. synced attribute's ID Example: `"1246d8b3-ac29-4015-8154-dea4434a73fa"`

## AuditEvent



- `created_at` — object. Search for record based on the created_at date
  - `created_at.gt` — string. Greater Than - search for events with a date greater than the value
  - `created_at.lt` — string. Less Than - search for events with a date less than the value
  - `created_at.eq` — string. Equal - search for events with a date equal to the value
- `subject_type` — string. Categorization of audit event. One of: ApprovalAction, AutomatedUser, AutomatedWorkflow, BatchWorkflow, CreateWorkflow, DelegateUser, Delegation, Delete, Email, ExpirationWorkflow, Form, FormAttribute, FormAttributeForm, Get, IdentityProofingResult, IdproxyPermission, IdproxyRole, InvitationWorkflow, LoginWorkflow, NeaccessRole, NeaccessUser, NeAttribute, NeAttributeOption, NeprofileRole, NeprofileUser, Notification, Page, PasswordResetWorkflow, Patch, Permission, Portal, PortalRegistrationWorkflow, Post, Profile, ProfilePage, ProfileType, ProfileTypeRole, RegistrationWorkflow, Role, RoleProfile, SamlConfiguration, SchemaMapping, SchemaMappingField, SecurityQuestion, UpdateWorkflow, User, UserManager, UserProfile, UserRole, Validation, VerificationEmail, Workflow, WorkflowAction, WorkflowPage, WorkflowSession. Example: `"Profile"`
- `type` — string. The type of audit event One of: AuditableProfileCreate, AuditableProfileUpdate, AuditableProfileDestroy, AuditableBulkProfileUpdate, AuditableProfileContributorAdd, AuditableProfileContributorRemove, AuditableProfileContributorRoleAdd, AuditableProfileContributorRoleRemove, AuditableProfileOwnerUpdate, AuditableProfileWorkflowEvent, AuditableWorkflowActionSkippedEvent, AuditableWorkflowApprovedEvent, AuditableWorkflowApprovedEvent, AuditableWorkflowAssignedEvent, AuditableWorkflowAutoAssignedEvent, AuditableWorkflowBatchCompleteEvent, AuditableWorkflowClosedEvent, AuditableWorkflowDuplicateCheckStartEvent, AuditableWorkflowDuplicateResolutionEvent, AuditableWorkflowFailedEvent, AuditableWorkflowIdentityProofedEvent, AuditableWorkflowInvitationSentEvent, AuditableWorkflowLdapProvidedEvent, AuditableWorkflowNotificationSentEvent, AuditableWorkflowPendingApprovalEvent, AuditableWorkflowPendingAssignmentEvent, AuditableWorkflowPendingFulfillmentEvent, AuditableWorkflowFulfilledEvent, AuditableWorkflowPendingIdentityProofEvent, AuditableWorkflowPendingLdapEvent, AuditableWorkflowPendingRequestEvent, AuditableWorkflowPendingReviewEvent, AuditableWorkflowProfileCreatedEvent, AuditableWorkflowProfileSelectEvent, AuditableWorkflowProfileUpdatedEvent, AuditableWorkflowRejectedEvent, AuditableWorkflowRequestMadeEvent, AuditableWorkflowRestApiEvent, AuditableWorkflowReviewedEvent, AuditableWorkflowRunningWorkflowEvent, AuditableWorkflowSoapApiEvent, AuditableWorkflowStatusChangedEvent, AuditableWorkflowStoredProcedureEvent, AuditableWorkflowUnassignEvent, AuditableWorkflowWaitingForWorkflowEvent, AuditableWorkflowWorkflowChangedEvent, AuditableWorkflowVersionCreatedEvent, AuditableWorkflowVersionForkedEvent, AuditableWorkflowVersionDeprecatedEvent, AuditableWorkflowVersionDeletedEvent, AuditableWorkflowStepCreatedEvent, AuditableWorkflowStepUpdatedEvent, ActiveRecordCreate, ActiveRecordUpdate, ActiveRecordDestroy, AuditableApiEvent. Example: `"AuditableProfileCreate"`
- `subject_id` — string. Identifier of the subject Example: `"7d8c53ca-e99d-485c-9524-ea3849e82c79"`
- `data` — object. 
  - `data.profile_id` — string. The profile id associated with the event
  - `data.workflow_id` — string. The workflow id associated with the event
  - `data.workflow_name` — string. The workflow name associated with the event
  - `data.workflow_uid` — string. The workflow uid associated with the event
  - `data.profile_type_id` — string. The profile type associated with the event
  - `data.workflow_version_id` — string. The workflow version a change belongs to. Can be used for both Workflow configurations and Workflow Session events.
  - `data.version` — string. The workflow version SHA.
  - `data.step_id` — string. The id of the workflow action or condition the step event refers to.
  - `data.step_label` — string. The name associated to an action configuration.
  - `data.source` — string. What triggered the versioning change. One of: ui, import, fork, cleanup_worker, delete_worker.

## Job



- `info` — string.  Example: `"job has started"`
- `job_status` — object. 
  - `job_status.job_id` — string. 
  - `job_status.status` — string. 
- `status` — integer.  Example: `200`

## Metadata



- `limit` — integer. 
- `offset` — integer. 
- `total` — integer. 
- `next` — string.  Example: `"/endpoint?limit=10&offset=60"`
- `previous` — string.  Example: `"/endpoint?limit=10&offset=40"`

## MetadataWithAfterId



- `limit` — integer. The maximum number of records to return in the search Example: `"/endpoint?limit=10"`
- `offset` — integer. The number of records to skip before starting to return results. Example: `"/endpoint?offset=60"`
- `total` — integer. The total number of records available matching the search criteria. Example: `"/endpoint?total=10"`
- `next` — string. The ID of the first record in the next set of results Example: `"/endpoint?limit=10&offset=60"`
- `previous` — string. The ID of the last record in the previous set of results Example: `"/endpoint?limit=10&offset=40"`
- `after_id` — string. The ID from which the search will start, ignoring all records before it. Example: `"4eaa719f-4312-4c5b-9264-d0eb04d4a02a"`

## InvalidJson



- `error` — object.  Example: `"Invalid JSON syntax. Please check your syntax and try again."`

## ValidationErrors



- `error` — object.  Example: `"The <object> failed to create/update"`
- `errors` — object.  Example: `{"attribute": "can't be blank"}`
